## Introduction

This report details the development and monitoring of a predictive model. The goal of this project is to create a robust model and establish a monitoring framework to track its performance over time.

## Data Preparation

We began by generating a synthetic dataset with a mix of numerical and categorical features, a timestamp, and a binary target variable. The data was then split into a "train" set and an "out-of-time" (OOT) set to simulate a real-world scenario where the model is used to predict on future data.

## Exploratory Data Analysis

We performed an exploratory data analysis (EDA) to understand the characteristics of the data. This included generating share-of-category and bad-rate plots for each feature.

### Share of Category

![Feature 2 Share of Category](plots/feature2_binned_share.html)
![Category 1 Share of Category](plots/category1_binned_share.html)

### Bad Rate by Category

![Feature 2 Bad Rate by Category](plots/feature2_binned_bad_rate.html)
![Category 1 Bad Rate by Category](plots/category1_binned_bad_rate.html)

## Feature Engineering and Selection

We used the Information Value (IV) and Population Stability Index (PSI) to select the most predictive and stable features for our model. `feature2_binned` and `category1_binned` were selected as the final features.

## Model Training and Evaluation

A logistic regression model was trained on the selected features. The model's performance was evaluated using the Area Under the Curve (AUC) and Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) statistic.

| Metric | Train  | OOT    |
|--------|--------|--------|
| AUC    | 0.9958 | 0.9974 |
| KS     | 0.9661 | 0.9766 |

## Rolling Model Monitoring

We implemented a rolling model monitoring framework to track the model's performance over time. The following charts show the monthly AUC and average predicted probability.

### Monthly AUC

![Monthly AUC](plots/monthly_auc.html)

### Monthly Average Predicted Probability

## Conclusion

The model is performing well and appears to be stable over time. The monitoring framework is in place to detect any future performance degradation.
